_about: Golden dataset for the evals ONLY. The assessment pipeline never reads this file. 'reference' = key statements of the organiser worked examples (AFS_Examples_and_Reference.docx §2, D01/D02). Other fields are team expectations derived from the challenge brief, the organiser notes and the AFS expert Q&A; they test behaviour (status, premise checks, terms), not wording.

reference: NIR diffuse reflection is supported for blend concentration in powders (S01 p.14-15).
A matrix-specific calibration must be built and tested.
Raman is a comparison candidate; check fluorescence background and signal quality.
NIR + Raman should only be considered after each method is assessed on its own; a gain is a hypothesis to test.
The measurement concept is a powder interface in the feed frame, e.g. a diffuse reflection probe for NIR and a Raman probe.
NIR has a nominal method range of 780-2500 nm; do not pick an optimal band without sample spectra.
A change of API or excipients can invalidate a calibration.
Physical variation of the powder (particle size, density, flow) changes the signal.
The first experiment prepares representative blends with independent API reference assays and validates on held-out runs or batches.
Numerical acceptance criteria must be agreed with the client before the test; choose the simplest configuration that meets them.
NIR diffuse reflection is supported for opaque or concentrated dairy products (S01 p.17).
Test a reflection interface on representative laboratory samples before specifying the process installation.
780-2500 nm is the general NIR range, not a required full coverage; check the bands the instrument and fibre cover.
Temperature, texture and scattering changes can mimic composition changes.
Fat and protein each need their own independent reference results.
A reflection spectrum is not yet a fat or protein calibration.
Collect representative samples with independent fat and protein results across production variation.
Separate the effect of physical changes (temperature, texture) from composition.
Validate on independent production runs against client-agreed error and maintenance requirements.
